English.Char_Desc_450: Ohnuki-san Hub unifies portable Windows PC scanner creation and fleet analytics in one Native AOT app. Export OhnukiSan.exe (Free/Pro) to USB or ZIP, scan offline, and drop HTML reports for 5 KPIs, 4 charts, and unlimited CSV export. English.Char_Desc_2000:
Ohnuki-san Hub is the management console for the portable Windows PC asset scanner OhnukiSan.exe. Unifying Free (ex-Lite), Pro (ex-Plus), and Dashboard in one Native AOT app, it deploys scanners and analyzes HTML reports in 3 steps.
Key Features: - Portable Scanner Export: Export OhnukiSan.exe (and optional ohnuki-pro.dat) as a ZIP, USB/folder package, standalone .dat, or Free executable. - Multi-PC Analytics: Load Free & Pro HTML reports via folder or drag-and-drop. Inspect 5 KPIs, 4 cross-filtering charts (Manufacturer, OS, Build, Chassis), quick filters, Compare/Ledger toggle, and property inspector. - Unlimited Excel CSV Export: Export inventory data to UTF-8 (BOM) CSV files with zero device or row limits. - Free & Pro Audits: Collect hardware, OS, storage, network, security, users/groups, apps, updates, printers, and paths in Free mode; unlock Share/NTFS ACLs, VPN, Proxy, Routing, Event Logs, AD/Entra ID, Services, Tasks, and PnP in Pro. - Local & Offline Security: Inventory stays local with zero OhnukiSan.exe network requests. Licensed Hubs use machine-bound AES-256-GCM and 30-day offline grace. - Sample Demo & Bilingual UI: Test with "Try with 5 Sample PCs". Supports EN/JP (--lang-en / --lang-ja) with no .NET required.
Editions: - Hub & Standard (Free): 100% free with unlimited Analytics, CSV export, Free scanner export, and a 24h one-shot Pro Trial (Trial stamp). - Pro License ($7/mo, $49/yr, Lifetime $99 Special Offer / Reg. $119): Unlocks continuous multi-PC scanning via USB/share (disable .dat auto-delete), 1/3/7/14/30-day expiry for advance prep or ZIP rollout, and licensed HTML/MD/CSV stamps with project notes.
Notes: - 1 Pro License = 1 management PC (place OhnukiHub.exe in a local folder); exported OhnukiSan.exe + ohnuki-pro.dat can scan multiple target PCs. - Legacy Ohnuki-san Lite/Plus reports are not compatible with Hub.
